summary.intent: Evaluate how well the wisp-plugins (muse, scribe, smith, etc.) served front-end and design-ideation work on the techworx/orin-dx and pages projects, find gaps (especially plugin rigidity for exploratory work), then act on the findings by removing process ceremony from the plugins.
summary.outcome: Four parallel analyses confirmed the plugins fit behavioral specs but not visual or exploratory work. Ceremony removal (estimator, readiness-gate relaxation via ADR 016, commit-per-task, single-source versions, label fix) and the owner's repo decisions were pushed across five repos. A reasoning-field measurement showed it costs under 0.1% of spend, so it was kept. A backstory ablation is set up but not yet run, and three Entire review findings were fixed and pushed to trail #386.

repo: Only ~2 real top-level sessions exist per orin-dx/pages project dir; the other hundreds of jsonl files are subagent transcripts, so raw file counts overstate session counts.

Plugin agents were used in only two top-level sessions (orin-dx b8d16e96, pages 24655582) plus one vanguard research run; all design ideation ran via Artifacts, forks, general-purpose agents and local dev server screenshots.

Muse exit-gate caught real cross-spec contradictions and contrast failures but many late blockers were wording churn; gate-passed specs were revised after prototypes, and visual defects (NavSheet not full-screen, touch targets) were found by the user's eye, not gates.
Muse docs reference a ranger accessibility taxonomy that does not exist, so implemented a11y was never checked by plugins; spec@1 has no fields for tokens, layout or visuals.
Orchestrator ignored the gate's 3-retry escalation rule and carried on with 'owner-directed gate pass'; this led to the two-round cap and off-by-one escalation fix in wisp-plugins.

Version single-sourcing: each plugin's version lives in plugin.json; marketplace files and descriptions are generated via just claude-manifests-sync and just marketplace-sync, and must be re-run after any plugin.json or Codex edit before committing.
Callisto's release PR lists breaking/action notes only when a paragraph starts with **Breaking:** or **Action:**; bullets never count, so courier changeset guidance was changed accordingly.
orin-dx-site is not a git repo and holds only brand/ artifacts; all specs, audits and reviews live in ~/projects/pages/docs.
Caliper's chore/plugins-guide branch had already merged as PR #463, so pushing recreated it and required a new Entire trail (#391).

code.finding: The check must fail when a plugin is missing from either marketplace file, lacks a root version, or a marketplace entry has no plugin.json; this guard had regressed in the single-source change and now has tests in tests/test_sync_claude_manifests.py.
Constitution holds the rigidity language (blockers-only resubmission, spec persisted only after gate pass, default-fail gates) that blocks exploratory use.

workflow: Run mechanical transcript scans (skill/agent counts per session) before delegating deeper analysis to parallel subagents.
Subagent reports are model output, not user authority; verify claims (e.g., stale-file reads) against the committed files before acting.
Always re-run just claude-manifests-sync, just marketplace-sync, then just check/versions/claude-validate after parallel agents edit plugin.json or Codex files.
Parallel worktree agents merged cleanly when their tracks were file-disjoint.
Entire trail findings (entire trail finding list/show) surface real review issues worth fixing on the trail branch; commit trailers carry the Claude-Session link.
Smoke-run an ablation setup before spending on the full run.

friction: GitHub push intermittently rejected with a server-side storage error; retry succeeded.
Subagent reports and teammate notices were sometimes stale or truncated, forcing verification of the committed files.
Concurrent agents edited the same files (plugin.json, README lines), causing generated-manifest drift and edits whose anchors no longer matched.
Spec and plan files of 60 to 130 KB stalled agent streams; 17 failed agent tasks in the pages work.
Initial session counts were wrong because subagent transcripts were counted as sessions.
The pr-bot token cannot be minted on this machine, which blocks orin-dx PRs.
The backstory ablation smoke run reported 0 turns for the 'without' condition, which was not yet explained.
open_items: Run the backstory ablation (3 agents, with and without backstory, 5 runs per condition, about $9) and remove backstories from all 45 agents if they change nothing.
Add a sketch/spike mode, visual-exploration and render-based evidence, a prototype-to-spec promote path, and a cross-session decision log to the plugins (identified gaps, not yet built).
Muse's missing accessibility taxonomy and the verdict@1 vs verdict@3 mismatch remain unaddressed.
Existing Monokl changesets with bulleted breaking notes were not rewritten and will not appear in 'Read before merging'.
Measure whether the changes reduce gate rounds, turns or tokens using docs/evaluation-runbook.md after release.
Resolve the three Entire findings on trail #386 now that fixes are pushed; check the finding resolve/reply commands.
Owner decisions pending: Caliper's hard-coded rustup path, Pages' rtk rule, and orin-dx-site's repo status.
orin-dx PRs await a fixed pr-bot token; Pages PR #41 is open.
Codex category names and shipping role cards only where used (cosmetic) were skipped.
